aws.name: region
aws.doc: The AWS region to deploy into, such as us-east-1. Left off, read from AWS_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or the profile.

aws.name: variablesKey
aws.doc: ARN of a KMS key to encrypt this account's variables with. Left off, ocel creates one.

gcp.name: project
gcp.doc: The Google Cloud project to deploy into. Left off, from GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, CLOUDSDK_CORE_PROJECT or gcloud config.

gcp.name: region
gcp.doc: The region to deploy into, such as us-central1, never a zone such as us-central1-f.

vps.name: deployKey
vps.doc: Path to the public key the ocel-deploy login accepts. Left off, the bootstrapping login's keys.

vps.name: proxy
vps.doc: What fronts this machine on ports 80 and 443. Left off, ocel runs its own proxy.

vps.name: ssh
vps.doc: The machine to deploy onto: a Host alias from ssh_config, or the destination spelled out.
